_comment: Pool liquidity in USD on base, deepest pool per symbol, from DexScreener. SNAPSHOT taken during pass 426 (2026-09-16) by Dune. This is a point-in-time reading: a pool can drain or fill, so depth attributed to an older tick or ghost row is an INFERENCE, not a measurement of that moment. Re-measure before relying on it. A value of 0 means DexScreener returned no base pool for that symbol at all. Used by scripts/money_button_dip_supply.py --depth-json and by data/roundtrip_cost_coverage.md.
_source: https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/search?q=<SYMBOL>%20USDC, filtered to chainId=base and baseToken.symbol==SYMBOL, deepest pool by liquidity.usd
